note: Four independent lifecycle emails. Each belongs to a DIFFERENT campaign/flow — do not bundle them into one sequence. File numbers 04-07 match the design prototype's numbering; there is no 01-03 in this handoff.

emails.placement: Email 1 of the post-purchase education flow. Follows the existing emails/04-ready.html shipping series.
emails.trigger: first order fulfilled (or delivered, if delivery events are available)
emails.send_limit: one per contact on their FIRST order only — do not send on repeat orders
emails.subject: One week in
emails.preheader: Week one is the habit. The rest of it takes longer — here is the honest timeline.
emails.notes: The dark hero is a two-column table: copy left, pre-composited dog-on-ink PNG right. The right cell is hidden under 620px (.sm-hide) — the copy must read on its own. Reply-to must land in a monitored inbox; the footer promises a same-day human reply.
emails.suppression: exit on refund or cancellation before day 7

emails.placement: Standalone conversion flow. Only for contacts on a ONE-TIME box, never for active subscribers.
emails.trigger: one-time 30-day box fulfilled AND no active subscription
emails.send_limit: one per one-time order; max one per contact per 60 days
emails.subject: About halfway through the jar
emails.preheader: A 30 day box goes quicker than it sounds. Subscribe and the next one lands before this runs out.
emails.notes: img/jar-counter.png is a FIXED artwork showing 15 of 30 taken. The count text above it is dynamic; if you send at a day other than 21 the artwork will disagree with the number — either keep the 21-day delay or commission additional counter frames. Prices are merge vars so they follow the live price list (design shows $115 struck through / $99).

emails.placement: Standalone loyalty flow. This is the only review ask in the lifecycle — do not stack another.
emails.delay: immediately on the second order being fulfilled
emails.send_limit: exactly one send per contact, ever
emails.subject: Two boxes in — a small favor
emails.preheader: A second box is the only endorsement that counts. Thank you.
emails.notes: share_url should deep-link to the review/UGC form with the contact and order pre-filled. Hero is pre-cropped to 600x254 — email clients ignore object-fit, so do not substitute an uncropped photo.
emails.suppression: exclude contacts who already submitted a review

emails.placement: Standalone transactional send. Fires regardless of marketing consent; it confirms an action the customer took.
emails.subject: Cancelled, as asked
emails.preheader: Your Subscribe & Save is off. Nothing else will ship, and the door stays open.
emails.notes: Only email in the set with an OUTLINED CTA and a dark footer — the tone is deliberately quiet, keep it. The paw watermark is pre-flattened onto paper (#FAF8F1) as img/paw-watermark.png because email clients support neither opacity nor rotate; its cell is hidden under 620px. restart_url must resume the same plan at the same price with no re-onboarding, as the copy promises.
emails.suppression: none — transactional. Send even to unsubscribed contacts.

type.headline: DM Sans 700, 38-40px / 40-42px, letter-spacing -0.042em
type.label: DM Mono 400-500, 9.5-11px, letter-spacing 0.16-0.22em, uppercase
type.fallbacks: DM Sans -> Arial/Helvetica; DM Mono -> Courier New. Outlook is forced to Arial via an mso conditional.
